fact: FinMark Trust says Zimbabwe, with the DRC and Lesotho, does not have comprehensive legislation of the Electronic Transactions Act kind, and that existing financial services, data protection and cybersecurity laws are adapted instead; the document gives no event date, so as_of is its published date 2026-06-18.

Veritas Zimbabwe says the Electronic Transactions and Electronic Commerce Bill, named in the President's October 2025 address, has not been presented in Parliament or published in the Gazette and is presumably still being drafted.
